refactor(host): the process is read once into a Host, and tests stop writing process.env (candybar-testing-ihvy.33e) (#585)

* refactor(host): the process is read once into a Host, and a launcher inherits what its owner hands it (candybar-testing-ihvy.33e)

src names process.env, os.homedir and os.tmpdir only in src/host.ts and the preload's main; every other file takes a Host, a World (host + launcher), or the parsed Locations / DaemonPaths. Launch options carry an envOverlay over the launcher's inherited environment, the module-level launcher singletons are gone, and a lint rule keeps it so.

* test(host): tests state their machine as a Host, and no test writes process.env (candybar-testing-ihvy.33e)

Every test that wrote XDG_*, the daemon socket, the breaker's variables or the like now builds a Host over the environment it names and hands it to the code under test; a child a test launches inherits its launcher's environment. A second lint config fails a write to process.env in test/, apart from the setup files, the in-worker harness and a PATH stub, and pnpm lint runs it. Memory notes the rule.

* fix(host): scripts build their world from src, gallery sets the debug switch, stale width comments go (candybar-testing-ihvy.33e)

docs(design): the isolated daemon, tmux events and browser surface designs
